notes: Site: headless Shopify behind Next.js/Vercel. Access: plain HTTP GET, desktop UA, no WAF, robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Navigation discovery: full mega-menu (11 top-level nodes, see bs218.json notes) has no 'New Arrivals'/'New In' node, but the homepage's own RSC-rendered merchandising sections include a section with productCollectionTitle 'New Launches' (site's own wording for 'recently added to the catalogue') with an 'Explore More' link to /collections/new-launch-new, previewing 4 products (Evita Copper Gifts set, etc.). Opened it: confirmed a real PLP (product grid + price/colour/size facets), not an editorial/lookbook page - it genuinely represents newly-launched products, matching the New Arrivals concept under the site's own 'New Launch' terminology. Counted via the same RULE-1 method as bs218.json/cl218.json: initialProducts.pageInfo.hasNextPage=false with 8 distinct gid://shopify/Product IDs = exhaustive. Grepped sitemap.xml (486 URLs) for new-/latest/just-in and found two more handles: new-launch and new-arrivals. /collections/new-launch is live and populated (4 distinct products) but every one of those 4 product IDs is a strict subset of the 8 IDs already enumerated under new-launch-new (confirmed by direct gid overlap check) - i.e. it is a superseded/legacy version of the same listing (matches the site's own '-new'/'-nw' suffix convention used elsewhere, e.g. bestseller vs bestseller-nw). Treated as an alias of the canonical new-launch-new and excluded per the brief's alias rule (kept the canonical, noted the merge decision here) rather than double-counting. /collections/new-arrivals is also a live route but its initialProducts.edges array is empty (0 products) - a dead/stale sitemap entry, consistent with the ~44 confirmed-stale sitemap URLs documented for this exact site in the prior Home-Decor pass - dropped per the zero-product rule. No other 'new'-themed candidates were found in the mega-menu, sitemap, or homepage text scan (also checked for Hindi/regional-language equivalents of 'new' - site renders 100% in English, en lang attribute, no non-English text found anywhere).
